definitions.name: Confluence Cloud Update Page
definitions.description: Update with the next explicit Confluence version number; retrieve current page first. A stale version fails rather than retrying.
definitions.documentation:
Update with the next explicit Confluence version number; retrieve current page first. A stale version fails rather than retrying. PUT /wiki/api/v2/pages/{pageId}. External write action; set confirmWrites=true and $retries=0 deliberately. Inputs: pageId (optional), title (optional), content (optional), version (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item, resource_id, title. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied. Setup: configure baseUrl (https://example.atlassian.net), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Confluence page/space/comment read and write permissions for selected endpoints; account email and API token. Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt. Synthetic example inputs: ```json { "pageId": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "title": "Updated synthetic page", "content": "

Fixture

", "version": 2 } ``` This example is documentation, not a run. Source: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/api-group-page/

definitions.documentation:
# Nullable String

ONF typed decoder outputs v1.

Explicit null or String; omission remains a separate socket-presence state.

Use this named type on matching Encode/Decode sockets. Values are JSON data;
this type performs no network request, model call, authentication, or business action.
Exact type ID and version must agree on both ends of a wire. JSON Schema rejects
incompatible values; formats are informational in ONF. Missing optional fields
and explicit null are different. Unknown fields remain lossless where permitted.
The matching codecs split useful properties or collection entries and reassemble
the original value. They never coerce strings/numbers or silently drop unknown data.

## Schema
```json
{
  "anyOf": [
    {
      "type": "string"
    },
    {
      "type": "null"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example JSON value
```json
"example"
```

Examples are synthetic. Null, collection, union and presence rules are defined by
the complete schema above; an empty example is not a claim every field is required.
Do not put credentials, tokens, or unnecessary business data into JSON records.

definitions.description: List Page Footer Comments. Returns a bounded result; provider permission and resource visibility apply.
definitions.documentation:
List Page Footer Comments. Returns a bounded result; provider permission and resource visibility apply.

GET /wiki/api/v2/pages/{pageId}/footer-comments. Read operation.

Inputs: pageId (optional), continuation (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, items, count, has_more, continuation. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://example.atlassian.net), basic credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Confluence page/space/comment read and write permissions for selected endpoints; account email and API token.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). Follow bounded provider continuation or pass continuation to fetch the next page. has_more reports an unconsumed continuation. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "pageId": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run. 

Source: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/api-group-comment/
